scripts.music: mkdir -p tmp/music && rolldown tools/music/render-track.ts -o tmp/music/render-track.mjs --format esm --platform node && for t in 2027 breaks acid; do node tmp/music/render-track.mjs $t tmp/music/digger-$t.wav && ffmpeg -y -v error -i tmp/music/digger-$t.wav -c:a libopus -b:a 128k -application audio public/audio/digger-$t.opus; done
